servicesSummary: State of Qatar Registrant provided non-registrable legal advice to the foreign principal with respect to legal proceedings related to coercive measures imposed on Qatar and Qatari individuals by Saudi Arabia, UAE, Bahrain, and Egypt. Registrant provided advice to the foreign principal to promote its legal and factual arguments with respect to issues of national importance to the foreign principal.
